text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Uhahaha!! This is the abso-freaking-lute 
beeeeest~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What a sight, Daitaku Helios! On the 
grand stage of a GⅠ race, she looks like 
she's having the time of her life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the GOAT, bar none!! Hype me up, 
legs! Keep on pumping~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahahaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's insane...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios... can just be "Helios" no matter 
where she goes, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I always thought I had to act 'proper.' 
Like McQueen, Ryan, and the others... 
fitting for the Mejiro family..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, no matter what I tried, I just 
couldn't do it well. Even when I acted 
cheerful, deep down, I didn't have any 
confidence at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Still... it's fine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Why not just run away, then?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw Palmer-chin, you're just Palmer-chin, 
right? Not just the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I am who I am... It's okay for me to run 
with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to stay true to myself, 
too... just like Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to shout that I am me, without 
bluffing. I want a 'me' that has no 
doubts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...If I can find it, will I be able to 
become like you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My... sun.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew~~~ That was crazy close!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't today way too intense!? I got 
seriously hyped up though!!"
choice_data_list: This is what a GⅠ race is all about.
This is what a GⅠ race is all about.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It sure does~!! GⅠ is totally insane!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna take this festive path! I wanna 
party hard in the GⅠ races~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P! Book the next venue!!

Just as we decided the other day, sticking 
to the sprint path will be the way for 
Daitaku Helios to shine brightest... her 
truest path. So—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Is that a GⅠ!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?
choice_data_list:
It's gonna be just as fiercely competitive 
of a race!

text_block_list.text:
This race, exclusive to Classic-year 
runners, gathers together same-generation 
talent aiming to make their mark on the 
sprint circuit from here on.
choice_data_list:
Even as a sprinter, I'll be the biggest 
party animal!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha! I'm like, totally, completely, 
utterly down for that...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm down! Let's go hit on Aoi-chan! ☆ Ah, 
not Trainer Kiryuin, to be clear!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, aren't all the racers besties? Let's 
make a group LANE chat~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can already tell for real that we're 
gonna make a huge racket next year too!

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you see me, Ojou? My total 
glow-up!"

Daiichi Ruby... I heard she was aiming to 
debut within the year, but couldn't make 
it in time. She's probably training hard 
for next year, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The next menu is... Cardio on the 
treadmill, and after that—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Did you see today's race?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No. Could it be the Hanshin JF?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Helios looked like she was in super 
high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I see. Overall, she is a cut above the 
rest of her generation, so that comes as 
no surprise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you really are amazing. Ah, I brought 
some tea, by the way.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the consideration. However, 
there is no need to extend it to me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, was I in the way?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's just, you looked like you were 
pushing yourself a little too hard."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I admit it is a harsh regimen. However, 
this is by no means an act of thoughtless 
desperation.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Next year's debut... and beyond that, it 
all begins with the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"It is time for us to build up your 
strength so you can achieve results on the 
Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The only achievement befitting my family's 
glorious legacy— is none other than the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ruby, you run for the sake of your 
family, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For that is the only way to repay 
everyone who has placed their hopes on me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's the same.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No. Hey, about afterwards... would it be 
okay if I helped out with your training 
too?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, given my physical condition and all, 
I like to think I know a thing or two 
about efficient training methods.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Did you not come to stop them?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: At first, maybe. But...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because I understand your desire to work 
hard for everyone's sake.
